title: Tatum, football and musicians' interest in sports
summary: Tatum was said to have been hurt playing football and loved it; they talk about Black football and baseball teams and band baseball games.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: To think of it also, Tatum was very interested in sports. In fact, I believe that he was very interested in football, because I heard -- I heard that Tatum, when he was young, before he became blind, that he had an accident while playing the game, football, in school or something like that, and even after he had his accident, he was still interested in football. I think that was his favorite sport.
Were there many Black guys playing football then? Was it like -- were they like -- did they have like, you know how they had like the Black baseball teams? Did they have Black football teams as well?
Well, they had a few, not as many as they do nowadays, but they had a few, sure, that -- yes, I think they even had a football team made up of just Black guys, you know.
Uh-huh. Did they play around New York?
I think so. They called them the Giants or something like that. I'm not sure. But I think I heard that there was a team made up -- I know they had a baseball team made up of Blacks.
Uh-huh, guys who were playing then.
Were many of the musicians in those days interested in sports, the guys that you knew?

Well, oh, I'd say about -- I don't think they were too interested. Some of the fellows I'd come in contact with or played with in music, some of them, every once in a while they would talk about baseball and who was their favorite teams, you know, baseball, football, and even a few of them were interested in golf, tennis even during those early days.
Of course, I wasn't too interested in the -- hardly
any sports. During my high school days I played a bit of basketball, and that was about it.
Did you -- you know, I have read that sometimes the teams -- I mean the different bands would have -- would have baseball games.
Yes, that's true. I heard that -- I think Count Basie had, some of his fellows formed a baseball team and possibly Duke Ellington also, you know, some of the big bands.
Did you ever see any of the games?
No. No, I never did. I think I saw one baseball game in my life, and that was back home they had a couple of school teams, you know, and that was it. I wasn't really interested in it.
